business_problem: In 2019, Globo merged five companies, covering approximately 18,000 employees and a large volume of legacy systems. Seeking to increase structure, standardize the environment, and establish governance, the company realized the opportunity to transform itself with modern and intelligent technologies.
solution_summary: Having started with the circulation of the O Globo newspaper in 1925, Globo Organizations today support a range of companies that, in turn, bring together a vast menu of products. Among these is the largest broadcaster in Latin America and the third largest in the world: TV Globo. In 2019, Globo merged five companies, covering approximately 18,000 employees and a large volume of legacy systems. Seeking to increase structure, standardize the environment, and establish governance, the company realized the opportunity to transform itself with modern and intelligent technologies. Within a few months, this movement was further driven by the pandemic’s introduction shortly after the merger, forcing Globo to work remotely, both collaboratively and productively.

solution_components.name: Power Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the low-code platform used to build and govern internal business applications and automations.

solution_components.name: Power Apps
solution_components.role: Delivers low-code business applications that digitize workflows and data capture for end users.

solution_components.name: SharePoint
solution_components.role: Stores and shares documents and structured content used across the workflow.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Teams
solution_components.role: Connects users, experts, or frontline staff for collaboration, communication, and workflow execution.

business_outcome: After the Hackathon, Globo had a 30% growth in overall Power Platform consumption, Power BI dashboard creation, and Power Automate applications. Today, the organization has approximately 16,000 dashboards in Power BI, 3,600 applications in Power Apps, with approximately 5,800 streams in its environment, running up to one million streams per month.
metrics: In 2019, Globo merged five companies, covering approximately 18,000 employees and a large volume of legacy systems.
The company realized the potential for use when it saw a 300% jump in the number of users over a one-month period at the beginning of this process.
Globo moved from 300 sites on the platform to 3,000 in six months, reaching 22,000 sites on SharePoint in mid-2022.
One of them automated the offboarding of employees, reducing a process that took around 40 days to execute to just seven.
After the Hackathon, Globo had a 30% growth in overall Power Platform consumption, Power BI dashboard creation, and Power Automate applications.
architecture_clues: Globo saw in Microsoft Teams , from Microsoft 365 , a timely tool to standardize and improve collaboration and communication among employees.
